meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Maximum-saturation research orchestration: ALWAYS proposes the final materials first (PDF+DOCX default), then parallel explore+librarian swarms across codebase, web, official docs, and OSS repos — max-roster teammode when the harness has it — with live journaling, a recursive EXPAND loop driven by leads workers return in message text, empirical verification by running code, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind a mandatory visual-QA gate. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research — the word 'ulw-research' in any prefix form, any 'ulw' research wording including combined invocations like 'mass ulw research', 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对任意主题做多源深度调研并产出带引用报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常需要覆盖多来源、有引用支撑的深度研究报告。
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate exhaustive multi-source research and produce cited synthesis reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need comprehensive research reports verified across many sources.

howto.what: 激活后，Claude 会以‘最大饱和度’模式做研究：先提议最终交付物（默认 PDF 和 Word），再并行派出多组探索者和图书管理员，覆盖代码库、网页、官方文档等来源，追踪线索、运行代码验证争议点，最后在视觉 QA 通过后交付带引用的综合报告、图表和流程图。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求研究、深度研究或超精确调查，或提到‘ulw-research’、‘ultradebate’等关键词（任意语言）时触发；普通问题、调试或实现上下文收集时不触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 帮我调研一下 Python 和 Go 的性能差异。
say.note: Claude 会启动最大饱和度研究，并行搜索后给出报告。

say.text: 做一次深度研究：比较 AWS、Azure 和 GCP 的定价模型。
say.note: 会触发研究流程，并最终交付带引用的对比报告。

say.text: 执行 hyperdebate 研究：开源 AI 是否比闭源更安全？
say.note: 会有至少两个辩论角色攻击论点，然后再形成结论。

howto.what_en: When active, Claude runs exhaustive research: proposes final materials (PDF+DOCX), spawns parallel swarms to explore codebases/web/docs/OSS, follows leads, verifies by code, delivers cited synthesis with charts after visual QA.
howto.when_en: Activates only on explicit research demands: 'ulw-research', 'ultradebate'/'hyperdebate', or deep-research asks in any language. Not for ordinary questions, debugging, or context-gathering.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to compare Python and Go performance.
say_en.note: Claude starts research and returns a cited report.

say_en.text: Do a deep research comparing AWS, Azure, and GCP pricing.
say_en.note: Triggers the research flow and delivers a compared report.

say_en.text: Run hyperdebate research: is open-source AI safer than closed?
say_en.note: Two adversarial roles attack claims before conclusions.
